Name: TANK_WHEEL_MODEL_PARAM
Description: Tank leg wheel model settings: the wheel joint each row moves and which wheel raycasts it follows.

Fields.Name: Base Bone Name
Fields.Description: Name of the wheel model joint.

Fields.Name: Raycast Wheel Index: Front
Fields.Description: Internal wheel control index of the front wheel whose raycast this joint follows.

Fields.Name: Raycast Wheel Index: Rear
Fields.Description: Internal wheel control index of the rear wheel whose raycast this joint follows.

Fields.Name: Bone Axis For Vertical Movement
Fields.Description: Axis along which the wheel model joint moves up and down.

Fields.Name: Front/Rear Reference Ratio
Fields.Description: Blend between the front and rear wheel indices. 0: 100% front, 1: 100% rear.
